independenceStatement: This review was performed independently from generation. Scores are based on inspected pixels, not route metadata, prompts, HTML, or declared provenance.
anchorUseBoundary: All anchor files were inspected read-only for transferable judgment. Their low-resolution project-cover format supports concept, hierarchy, composition, and system comparison but does not prove micro-craft; no anchor pixels were copied, modified, or used as candidate proof.

observations: The three image-led posts share the same upper headline, lower hero-object, and corner-logo skeleton, so beige-dark-beige alternation does not prevent a template rhythm.
Material, lighting, and focal assets are coherent, but the first and third tiles are near-identical in balance and text placement.
The image quality raises the feed above the old engine, yet the series needs at least one materially different crop, type-image interaction, or edge behavior.
The set gains useful range across photoreal heroes, dark editorial work, light infographics, and a product-principle tile.
It currently feels like two adjacent systems: three cinematic image-led posts and six flat posters unified mostly by palette, novelty display type, and logo placement.
Small captions, micro-labels, and evidence diagrams repeatedly disappear at feed scale, weakening informational authority.
The three-slide Arabic carousel adds logical progression and the final English brand breath gives the sequence a useful visual pause.
Slides nine through eleven still depend on the same corner metadata, logo position, limited green palette, and flat mechanism treatment, so progression is verbal more than cinematic.
Across twelve posts, recurring display-font dominance and bottom-corner signatures risk becoming the next template even though individual grids vary.

preciseFeedPriorities: Break the identical image-led skeleton before generating another three-post sequence: vary focal scale, crop, headline-image interlock, and logo-side balance while retaining only material and charge behavior.
Treat the display face as a limited brand instrument, not the default for every English headline, label, and support line.
Set a hard mobile rule that no evidence label or qualification may survive only as decorative fine print.
Make carousel progression visible through changing action, depth, and state—not only through numbered cards and repeated palette furniture.
Do not resume production from feed coherence alone; the current set has zero independent 145-plus art-direction outcomes.

reasons: The new asset replaces a generic information card and operating-map furniture with one message-specific material handoff that reads before the supporting text.
The new hierarchy is faster and more spatially decisive, with a single focal junction rather than several equal cards, labels, and body-copy blocks.
The new material, light, and crop provide substantially more visual craft and distinctiveness, while the old asset remains clean but unmistakably template-led.

The new asset still scores only 136 because its type-image integration, connector finish, and support hierarchy remain below professional anchors; winning this pairwise comparison is not release evidence.

overallVerdict.summary: The rebuild decisively improves on the old engine and establishes a credible AURENDOR material and typographic world, but it has not yet reached repeatable professional quality. No asset meets 145/160 from this independent critic; the feed still exposes template rhythm, small-text failures, and a split between cinematic imagery and flat diagrams.
